audio_video: descriptors declared (MediaKind/StreamDesc carry Audio/Video); no backend operations implemented

backend.adapter: tools/media_backend.py (argv in, JSON out, timeouts, bounded logs)
backend.backend_for: codec math, container parsing, resampling bytes, file I/O
backend.choice: Pillow 12.3.0 (image ops) + FFmpeg 8.1.2 ffprobe (independent probe cross-check)
backend.isolation: direct argv, no shell construction; version provenance per result
backend.not_backend_for: semantics, specs, validation, geometry, budgets, failures

binary_model.buffers: fixed-size [byte; N] tiles; int literals adapt to byte; `as` crosses byte<->u64
binary_model.copying: whole-frame bounded path; no per-pixel host/MNCS crossing in hot loops; large-buffer zero-copy untested by design (M-001)
binary_model.slices_views: not available/tested; future streaming slice must re-test
binary_model.streaming: whole decoded frames only; no async stream framework (deferred, decided)

cost_model: probe is cheap metadata; decode/resize/encode are explicit effectful backend ops; plans never hide decode cost
decoded_vs_encoded: encoded = container bytes; decoded = format-stated frames/pixels; native kernels operate only on decoded tiles
failure_model: 10-code taxonomy (UnsupportedFormat/Malformed/Truncated/BackendUnavailable/Decode/Encode/InvalidTransform/ResourceLimit/Cancelled/IoFailure) + bounded FailCtx; truncated header and wrong magic pinned

history.obsolete_paths_removed: none existed; no parallel implementations created

metadata_policy.provenance: backend id+version per result, fixture manifest, op params; lineage hooks preserved, no history DB
metadata_policy.transform_policy: Preserved/Rewritten/Dropped per plan (geometry always Rewritten; DropsAlpha/BackendDefined mark Dropped)

native_coverage: descriptors, formats, dims, timebase, streams, specs, budgets, failures, manifests, tile pixel ops are MNCS; codec bytes are host
orientation_color: orientation preserved as metadata, not normalized; channel counts named, colorimetry not modeled; RGB->gray is BackendDefined

M-002.summary: reserved words (`over`) bite natural binding names

M-003.summary: resampling conventions must be declared (PIL-center vs native top-left pinned)

M-004.summary: rational timebase needed no new primitives

M-005.summary: lossy-codec verification policy still to be defined

resource_posture: budgets (max lane, max bytes) checked from declared dims before trust; lane check precedes byte multiplication; decode bombs are structured data
rights_note: rights-adjacent metadata extracted/preserved only; rights-provenance (active) interprets; untouched
security_note: maintained backends (Pillow/FFmpeg); no custom binary parsing beyond 8-byte magic match; argv+timeouts+bounded logs; no sandboxing claims
time_model: rational num/den rates; integer-microsecond durations, explicit truncation order; GCD reduction; cross-multiplied equality; no float fps; no calendar

verification.independent_backends: PIL vs ffprobe agreement pinned; numpy top-left sampling cross-checks native kernel
